### Vocabulary in scope

New at this step:
- composite (also: Composite) — it is necessary that each composite is seen as exactly one whole (HCP L2 — Composite (whole, part): the object type of a whole and its parts)
- whole — it is necessary that each whole comprises at least 1 part (HCP L2 — Composite)
- part — it is necessary that each part is a part of exactly one whole (HCP L2 — Composite)
- decomposition (also: Decomposition) — it is necessary that each decomposition carves exactly one whole (HCP L2 — Decomposition (atom, union): how a whole is carved into parts)
- aggregation licence (also: Assembles) — it is necessary that each aggregation licence licenses exactly one kind of property (HCP L2 — Assembles: the aggregation licence, keyed by the sort of the whole and the kind)
- assembly (also: assemble) — it is necessary that each assembly folds exactly one decomposition (HCP L2 — assemble: fold a licensed quantity over a decomposition)
- extensive kind (also: Extensive) — it is obligatory that each extensive kind is licensed by at least 1 aggregation licence (HCP L2 — Extensive: a kind whose value over a union is the sum over its parts)
- dedicated kind (also: DedicatedKind) — it is necessary that each dedicated kind is dedicated to exactly one sort of system (HCP L2 — DedicatedKind, KindOfProperty.dedicatedTo: the pair's normal-mode frequency)
- component (also: Component) — it is necessary that each component is a component of exactly one whole (HCP L2 — Component: a named component of a system's characterization)
- pair (also: coupled pair) — it is necessary that each pair couples at least 1 body (HCP L2 — The pair is a system too)
- displacement (also: spring extension, displacementK) — the quantity kind `displacement` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- *composite* is seen as *whole* — verb
- *whole* comprises *part* — verb
- *part* is a part of *whole* — verb
- *decomposition* carves *whole* — verb
- *aggregation licence* licenses *kind of property* — verb
- *kind of property* is licensed by *aggregation licence* — verb
- *assembly* folds *decomposition* — verb
- *dedicated kind* is dedicated to *sort of system* — verb
- *component* is a component of *whole* — verb
- *pair* couples *body* — verb

Carried from earlier steps:
- L1: bearer, nominal name, individual quantity, same-bearer arithmetic, difference law, squared angular frequency
- L0: quantity, dimensioned kind, oscillator, body, spring, wall, oscillator mass, oscillator stiffness, mass, spring constant, angular frequency, frequency
- PKC: system context, sort of system, kind of property, dimension, object
- Foundation: artifact, system, model, requirement, check, finding, evidence, persona, step, event, trace, span, command, sender, receiver, port, abstraction map
